name: Aaron and The Void
source:
Aaron Thompson, a white-tailed deer, is from a world you created in your own imagination. Inexplicably, you become him in real life -- which sounds like a dream come true! -- but you must navigate through the complexities of his life. 

How? Through love, of course! Each partner you meet has their own personal problems to solve, and it's up to you to help them through it - all the while managing your own.

It's the only way you may be able to return home....

[From [url=https://eyematerror.itch.io/aaron-and-the-void]Itch.io[/url]]
